mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of dual-trigger instances.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 105 indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% YoY signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise, indicating inflation concerns, the S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of dual-rise instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth rate predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with no specific trigger required.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 950k units signals a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of mid-cycle quarters with HOUST > 950k.
